clauses.title: Personal Property Coverage
clauses.text: We insure personal property you own or use against direct physical loss from a covered cause, up to the personal property limit in your Declarations.

clauses.title: Personal Liability Coverage
clauses.text: We pay damages for which an insured is legally liable because of bodily injury or property damage arising from a covered occurrence, up to the liability limit in your Declarations.

clauses.title: Replacement Cost Settlement
clauses.text: We settle covered personal property losses at the cost to repair or replace with like kind and quality, without deduction for depreciation.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: A deductible of $500 applies to each covered loss unless a different amount is shown in your Declarations.

clauses.title: Special Limit – Jewelry and Watches
clauses.text: Theft of jewelry, watches and furs is limited to $5,000 per occurrence.

clauses.title: Special Limit – Business Property
clauses.text: Business property on the residence premises is covered up to $2,500 per occurrence.

clauses.title: Endorsement – Identity Recovery
clauses.text: We reimburse up to $15,000 of identity recovery expenses per policy period. This endorsement is included at no additional premium.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Motor Vehicles
clauses.text: We do not cover motorized land vehicles except those used solely to service the residence premises or assist the handicapped.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Flood and Earth Movement
clauses.text: Loss caused by flood, tidal water, earthquake, landslide or other earth movement is not covered.
